synthesis.body: Git resolves a pathspec relative to the current directory, not the repository root. A helper that takes a directory, changes into it, and lists a tree with a root-relative pathspec therefore searches for that path nested under itself, matches nothing, and exits zero. There is no error to catch, so a best-effort wrapper reads the empty result as 'nothing on the remote'. Run the call from the repository root with a root-relative pathspec, or ask the lister for the full tree. The defect survived review and a green suite because the fixture built its records at the repository root, where the relative path is empty and the pathspec degrades to the current directory — the one shape where the two coincide, and no real caller is shaped that way. A fixture whose directory layout differs from production is exercising a different function; one assertion against the real tree is cheaper than the suite that missed it.

title: A git-pathspec helper must be asserted from a real repository subdirectory, not a root-level fixture
